_about: NMC register colleges matched to our institutes by hand, 2026-10-20 (Admin → Data sync had 138 MBBS + 82 MD/MS left after the matcher fix). Each pairing was checked against the NMC register entry itself (name, earlier names, state, university, year of inception) and our institute's own counselling rows; where we hold two entries for one college, the MD/MS entry (MCC naming) is chosen over the DNB/Diploma one (NBEMS naming, with a PIN code). 'none' means no institute of ours is that college at that level today: 34 MBBS colleges given NMC permission in 2026 that are in no counselling list we hold, plus the cases noted. Applied by scripts/apply_nmc_decisions.ts.
